research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Vayyar is engaged in developing radar-based systems for applications such as monitoring activity in parked vehicles, gesture recognition, telemedical health monitoring, vehicle cabin occupancy detection, and retail shelf monitoring. Their work includes systems for imaging concealed surfaces, scanning for concealed objects, shaping beams produced by antenna arrays, and providing wide beam radar arrays. These efforts span automotive, medical, and retail sectors, highlighting advancements in 4D imaging radar sensor technology.

overview_description.description:
Vayyar manufactures 4D imaging radar that provides solutions for senior care, automotive, security, smart home, robotics, and more. It aims to deliver the next generation of sensing technology that is miniature, affordable, and versatile enough to impact everyone's lives, enabling a safer world.

The company was founded in 2011 and is based in Yehud-Monosson, Israel.

about_short_description.short_description: Vayyar is a semiconductor company that produces 4D imaging radar sensors for automotive, medical, and retail industries.

product.name: 4D Imaging Radar-on-Chip
product.description: A radar sensor chip covering 3-81GHz with up to 72 transceivers for high-resolution 4D imaging and sensing.

product.name: Automotive Safety Solutions
product.description: Radar-based systems for in-cabin monitoring, ADAS, and external vehicle safety using multifunctional single-chip platforms.

product.name: Vayyar Care
product.description: A passive, touchless sensor system for health monitoring and fall detection in senior care environments.

product.name: Retail Analytics Solutions
product.description: 4D radar sensors for real-time in-store customer monitoring, inventory tracking, and shopper behavior analysis without cameras.

product.name: Smart Building Monitoring Systems
product.description: Radar-based sensors for real-time occupancy detection, safety monitoring, and building automation optimization.

product.name: Wall Scanners
product.description: Radar-based devices that detect objects and structures inside walls to assist in safe drilling and construction.
